g.text: Synthetic 2 km × 2 km scenes, 5 m pixels, 170 craters of 12–110 m radius with random erosion, albedo and noise. Template: normalised cross-correlation with an
ideal crater rendered at the true sun angle. Network: 256–64–1 perceptron trained on patches from ten other scenes under random lighting. (d) Position fix by
RANSAC matching of the 40 best detections to the crater catalogue, three test scenes per sun angle.
